head: c54a948622e1172fe9e6aba59c2afecffabfee64
notes: Scoped run per binding user instruction: related tests only, lint/format/type-check scoped to changed files where possible. Per user instruction npm ci was NOT run (node_modules exists), although codemie-ui AGENTS.md asks for a reinstall before trusting test/typecheck results. Backend working tree carries an uncommitted src/codemie/datasource/loader/git_loader.py change not on this branch; it was neither linted nor reverted, and pytest imported the working-tree version. Gate logs: gate-logs.local/*.log.

gates.notes: Guide Run is `npm run lint` (whole repo); scoped to the 4 changed files per user instruction. Also covers lint-staged `eslint --fix` hook step (run non-mutating).
tsc --noEmit over whole project; also covers lint-staged `tsc --noEmit` hook step.
Guide Skip if: no dependency added, removed, or moved; package.json and package-lock.json unchanged in merge_base...HEAD.
Output read, not just exit code: gitleaks via Podman printed 'no leaks found' (~33.22 MB scanned). Scans working tree only, not git history. Also the pre-commit hook step.

Guide Run is `npm run test:unit:slnt` (whole suite); scoped to src/pages/dataSources per user. 'Test Files  23 passed (23)', 'Tests  203 passed (203)'. `vitest list` confirmed both changed test files (IntegrationSection.test.tsx, useEditPopup.test.ts) are in the set.
Guide Run is `npm run test:integration:slnt`; scoped to src/pages/dataSources per user. 'Test Files  3 passed (3)', 'Tests  25 passed (25)'.

Outside requested scope (user: no whole suites). Guide says never skip for MR compliance: still owed before opening the MR (needs stack up + ~/.codemie/test-harness.json; summary goes in the MR '## Test harness' section).
lint-staged `prettier --write` run as non-mutating --check: 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'

Hook runs `npm run license-headers:check` over all files; scoped to changed files. 'Checked 4 files, 0 missing license headers'. Guide's pre-commit table documents but does not gate this; ran as union.

Self-skip: '[sonar-local] Skipping Sonar scan because SONAR_TOKEN is not set.' Enable with SONAR_TOKEN (env or .env.local) and reachable Sonar host; note it then runs `npm run test:coverage` (full suite). Still owed; only CI/compliance can settle.
Repo pipeline only waits for external contexts 'ci-pipeline' and 'compliance-report' defined outside this repo; nothing locally runnable.
Guide Run is `make ruff` (mutating format + fix over repo); run non-mutating and scoped to the 6 changed files. '6 files already formatted'.

gates.command: poetry run ruff check <6 changed .py files>
gates.notes: 'All checks passed!'. Pre-commit hook runs full-repo `ruff check`; not run full-repo per user scope.
Outside user-requested scope (tests + ruff on changed files); poetry build writes dist/ artifacts outside run_dir.
Equivalent of `make license-check FILE=...` scoped to changed files; 'Checked 6 files, 0 missing license headers'. Pre-commit hook step 2.b runs it repo-wide.

Guide Skip if Docker unavailable: '/usr/bin/sh: line 1: docker: command not found' (Podman present but Makefile hardcodes docker). Enable with a docker CLI/alias to podman. Backend working tree not secret-scanned this run; still owed.
Hook scans staged diff only (`gitleaks protect --staged`); branch changes are already committed and nothing is staged, so there is no input.
Guide Run is `make test` (whole tests/); scoped to the 4 changed test files per user. '142 passed, 19 warnings in 55.35s'.
Guide Skip if: change does not touch src/codemie/repository/cli_analytics/postgres/.
Guide Skip if: user did not request coverage.
Self-skip: '[sonar-local] Skipping Sonar scan because SONAR_TOKEN is not set.' Enable with SONAR_TOKEN (env or .env.local); it then runs full pytest unless SONAR_SKIP_TESTS is set. Still owed.
Composite of ruff, license, gitleaks, full test; components run individually and scoped per user.
Outside requested scope; needs the stack + ~/.codemie/test-harness.json. Required in MR description for compliance bot; still owed before MR.

gates.command: bash scripts/git-hooks/commit_msg.sh <message file> (each of 4 commits in merge_base..HEAD)

gates.notes: Opt-in hook (CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED, default false) running full pytest + sonar; full suite excluded by user instruction.
Pipeline only waits for external contexts 'ci-pipeline' and 'compliance-report'; guide states no in-repo pipeline runs these gates.
